clips.title: The story
paras: Beyond the Moonshrine Sanctum, Aku'mai's Lair lies beneath Blackfathom Deeps. In its flooded depths, cultists and naga gather around Aku'mai, a hydra they honor as a servant of the Old Gods.

Four braziers flank a naga statue behind the Moonshrine Sanctum's sealed double doors. Lighting them awakens guardians sworn to defend the threshold. Beyond the doors, a sunless grotto lies beneath the water. Twilight's Hammer cultists and invading naga gather there in reverence of Aku'mai, an ancient, three-headed hydra they consider a living servant of the Old Gods.

Twilight's Hammer cultists see Aku'mai as an omen of a promised age of darkness. They believe the beast's emergence and continued sustenance will herald the breaking of subterranean prisons holding their ancient deities. Sacrificial offerings feed Aku'mai, while dark magic guards the pool where it dwells. The cult's plans center on this beast as ancient evil claws its way back into Kalimdor.
